step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified core services from visual inventory and transcript: Kinesis, DMS, S3, Step Functions, EMR, Athena, Redshift, SageMaker, and QuickSight.
2. Ingestion layer: Kinesis (streaming data) and DMS (database CDC/static ingestion) send raw landing data directly to Amazon S3.
3. Processing layer: Step Functions orchestrates EMR batch jobs that read landing data from S3, process it via Spark, and write back normalized Parquet data to S3.
4. Querying & Data Lake layer: Athena queries S3 Parquet data via the Glue catalog and loads aggregated data into Redshift.
5. Consumption layer: SageMaker accesses data from S3 directly, as well as via Athena and Redshift for predictive maintenance ML models. QuickSight queries Redshift for business intelligence reporting.
